title: Starting behind the scenes.
body: Before I was building whole products, I was working on the code behind them. Mamikos was where I started, moving from an internship into a backend engineering role.

title: A new place to build.
body: Next came Mekari, where I continued building the backend. The move into full-stack work came with my next chapter.

title: Finding a rhythm as a team.
body: TenderBoard brought two firsts: my first international company and my first full-stack role. My work now stretched from what people saw on screen to the code behind it. I also helped the team move into sprints, giving us a shared rhythm for planning and building together.

title: Bringing the pieces together.
body: At SeeMeSol, I took the lead on SeeMeApp, a Super App spanning four domains. Alongside building it, I worked on the less visible things that make a product feel better: faster pages, leaner queries and deployments that run automatically.

title: Growing into a product mindset
body: Building AI features like SamurAI changed how I thought about my work. I started looking beyond the brief: what does someone actually need here, and what would make this easier for them? I began taking ideas a step further, putting more care into the details that make a product feel effortless to use.
